QuestInfo.name: Liquid Memory Maker
QuestInfo.0: The Temple Keeper said he thought of a brilliant way to retrieve memories.
QuestInfo.1:
You were told that if you go see the Sorcerer, one who can make ANYTHING happen. 

If you can't access that area yet, you must receive permission from the Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.2: You went to the Sorcerer's Room, which is connected to Resting Spot of Regret.

0.0: Before you go...\r\nThere is something I want to talk to you about... quietly.

yes.0: I might have a plan to get my memories back... I just don't know if I can do it myself.
yes.1: I was hoping you could visit the #b#p2140002##k for me. He's a greedy good-for-nothing, but he might be able to make some kind of medicine for me. He's usually in the Sorcerer's Room, which is connected to Resting Spot of Regret.

1.0: I thought I made it clear that I don't take regular visitors! Who are you and why are you here?

npc.0: The Sorcerer is in his Sorcerer's Room, which can be accessed from the Resting Spot of Regret.
